E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Tough Love: After leaving his real estate firm to strike out on his own, Phil decides that a solo camping trip in the wild is just what he needs to boost his confidence. (S9 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Baby You Can't Drive My Car: Marge and Homer work together at a cool tech company that makes self-driving cars. But the cars have a sinister secret app... (S30 Ep5/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Werking Mom: Marge becomes a successful Tupperware salesperson and Lisa tries to do secret good deeds for people. (S30 Ep7/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Jenson receives a shocking revelation from Gemma. Leah turns to splashing the cash to try and keep her podcast idea running smoothly. And residents bond over football.

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Dee Dee finds herself the centre of attention and Beth is left startled by a name on a flower order. Elsewhere, things look promising for one couple when true feelings are shared.

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Homer Goes to Prep School: Homer joins an off-the-grid survivalist group who have a top-secret doomsday bunker. (S24 Ep9/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Below Deck Mediterranean
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: The deck team come under fire. A promotion on the interior team leaves one stew feeling extremely envious. And an unexpected hookup makes waves. (S10 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: What do the Goggleboxers think of Squid Game: The Challenge, The Couple Next Door, Strictly Come Dancing, The Graham Norton Show, Planet Earth III, and Jingle All the Way? (S22 Ep14)

E4Plus1.uk.description: The Goggleboxers watch Saltburn, Gladiators, First Dates: Be My Valentine, Trigger Point, This Morning, The Repair Shop, Bring the Drama, and BBC News on Joe Biden. (S23 Ep1)
